A LITTLE LIZARD, A BIG ADVENTURE

Evolution Island

Eat food and grow through 50 creatures to become a T. rex! Explore with other players and six roaming bots. Create a room or enter a friend's code.

The creator chooses the mode. Share the room code with friends!

Move with WASD / arrow keys or the buttons. Eat glowing food to evolve!

Up to 8 players + 6 bots · Normal: touch a smaller player to eat them; bigger players can eat you. Same-size players cannot eat each other. Ice Ice Ice eliminates nearby creatures in Normal mode, with a 3-minute cooldown. Friendly: players cannot harm each other.
